## Summary

Describe the specific change and the GitHub Issue it addresses (if any).

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation or literature
- [ ] Reproducibility, CI or repository maintenance
- [ ] Bug fix with documented impact
- [ ] New analysis/extension (separate from locked Phase 1 results)

## Scientific impact

- **Data, target or predictors affected:**
- **Model/preprocessing/threshold affected:**
- **Results, figures or provenance affected:**
- **Is this a correction to the frozen Phase 1 analysis?** Yes / No. If yes, explain and link to the issue.

## Checks

- [ ] `python scripts/check_repository.py` passed, or the reason it could not be run is documented
- [ ] Updated links and paths checked
- [ ] No raw XPT files, secrets or personal data included
- [ ] All newly introduced citations checked against original sources (if applicable)
- [ ] Research claims accurately describe prevalent self-reported MI/CHD, not prospective prediction or clinical diagnosis
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` / `docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md` updated if this changes a milestone or project phase

## Evidence and limitations

Summarise validation performed and outstanding uncertainties. Do not claim a clean-kernel or empirical rerun unless one was actually performed.
